def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=collections.Counter(c for r in g for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=np.zeros((H,W),bool); comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i,j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i,j]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    x,y=st.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                        a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and not seen[a,b] and g[a][b]==g[x][y]:
                            seen[a,b]=True; st.append((a,b))
                r0=min(p[0] for p in cells); c0=min(p[1] for p in cells)
                r1=max(p[0] for p in cells); c1=max(p[1] for p in cells)

                              'r0':r0,'c0':c0,'r1':r1,'c1':c1})
    out=[[int(g[i][j]) for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    big=[cc for cc in comps if cc['n']:=sum([1 for _ in cc['cells']])>1]
    # use n directly via len(cells)
    return out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=collections.Counter(c for r in g for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    C=comps_of(g,bg)
    out=[[int(g[i][j]) for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    bigs=[cc for cc in C if len(cc['cells'])>1]; singles=[cc for cc in C if len(cc['cells'])==1]
    for bb in bigs:
        col=bb['col']
        for x in range(bb['r0'],bb['r1']+1):
            for y in range(bb['c0'],bb['c1']+1):
                out[x][y]=col
    for s in singles:
        rs,r_=s['r0'],s['r1']; cs_,ce=s['c0'],s['c1']
        e0,e1,c0a,c1a=rs-1,r_+1,cs_-1,ce+1
        hit=[cc for cc in bigs if cc is not None or True]
        hits=[bb_ for bb_ in bigs if max(e0,bb_['r0'])<=min(e1,bb_['r1']) and max(c0a,bb_['c0'])<=min(c1a,bb_['c1'])]
        if hits:
            best=min(hits,key=lambda cc:(cc['r0']-rs)**2+(cc['c0']-cs_)**2)
            out[rs][cs_]=best['col']

    # group by color; merge touching same-color comps
    from collections import defaultdict
    grp=defaultdict(list)
    for cc in C: grp[cc['col']].append(cc)
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for col,cs in grp.items():
        # sort by position
        cs.sort(key=lambda x:x['r0']*1000+x['c0'])
        groups=[]; cur=[cs[0]]
        for s in cs[1:]:
            p=s['r0']*(2)+s['c0']  # key
            q=cur[-1]['r0']*2+cur[-1]['c0']
            if p<=q+2: cur.append(s)
            else: groups.append(cur); cur=[s]
        groups.append(cur)
        # keep groups that are themselves rectangular-ish (solid or near-solid)
        res=[]
        for g_ in groups:
            rs=min(a['r0'] for a in g_); r1=max(a['r1'] for a in g_)
            cs_=min(a['c0'] for a in g_); c1=max(a['c1'] for a in g_)
            area=(r1-rs+1)*(c1-cs_+1); cells=sum(len(a['cells']) for a in g_)
            res.append((g_,rs,r1,cs_,c1))
        # choose largest/first; paint bbox
        pick=res[0] if True else max(res,key=lambda t:t[2]-t[1]+1*t[3])  # placeholder
    return None
